description: List the Google searches a domain ranks for in one country, with position, URL, volume, difficulty and estimated traffic. Defaults to this store; pass a competitor’s domain to compare. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

language.description: Language code, e.g. "en". Defaults to the store’s language.

location.description: Target country, e.g. "United States". Ask the merchant which countries they sell to if unknown.

pathPrefix.description: Only URLs under this path, e.g. /blogs/.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: get_ranked_keywords
title: Get ranked keywords
